mechanism_narrative: The sustained decline in retail and recreation mobility over the past four weeks indicates a persistent trend of reduced discretionary outings, which will continue to drive RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A severe and sustained decline in transit station mobility, falling below -65% from baseline, signals increasing public caution or stricter travel advisories, which will suppress retail and recreation activity over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than over the last 14 days, despite TRANSIT remaining below -65%.

mechanism_narrative: The concurrent rise in residential mobility and decline in workplace mobility indicates a strong shift towards staying home and reduced commuting, which collectively reduces opportunities for retail and recreation over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days, while RESIDENTIAL remains high and WORKPLACES remains low.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of tightening restrictions, a significant week-on-week decline in grocery and pharmacy mobility suggests reduced essential outings, which will further depress non-essential retail and recreation over the next week.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is higher than the previous 7 days, despite GROCERY_PHARM falling by more than 5 points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: The consistent increase in residential mobility over the past four weeks indicates a sustained preference for staying at home, directly reducing participation in retail and recreation activities over the next four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in parks mobility, falling below -30% from baseline, indicates reduced outdoor leisure activities, which will negatively impact general retail and recreation mobility over the next two weeks as people avoid public spaces.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than over the last 14 days, despite PARKS remaining below -30%.

mechanism_narrative: The combined effect of severely reduced transit usage and declining essential grocery trips suggests a broad-based reduction in all forms of public movement, indicating a strong likelihood of further declines in retail and recreation over the next four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: In a generally declining mobility environment, a slight week-on-week recovery in workplace mobility, even from a low base, might signal a very minor, localized easing of restrictions or return to work, potentially slowing the decline in RETAIL_REC over the next week.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises week-on-week by at least 0.5 points
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days continues its sharp decline, despite WORKPLACES showing a slight week-on-week increase.
